description: Eight neonates each have a general anaesthetic whose mean pressures test how long a pressure below 40 stands: ten arterial readings below 40 a minute apart, with a death 30, 90 or 91 days after the date of the start, a low cuff reading followed by the next reading 20 minutes later, low readings ten minutes before the start and an hour after the end, a low last reading two minutes before the end, a low last reading of an anaesthetic with no recorded stop, and a cuff mean of 35 beside an arterial mean of 50 with the same time.

expectations.says: The child is a neonate of 10 days at the start and died 30 days after the date of the start, so the child counts as having died within 90 days.
expectations.query: SELECT a.age_days, COUNT(d.person_id) AS died_within_90_days FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id LEFT JOIN omop.death d ON d.person_id = a.person_id AND d.death_date >= CAST(a.start_datetime AS date) AND d.death_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, CAST(a.start_datetime AS date)) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990002400' GROUP BY a.age_days

expectations.says: The ten arterial readings below 40, a minute apart, stand for exactly ten minutes, and the query keeps 17 readings.
expectations.query: WITH reading AS (SELECT a.anaesthetic_id, a.end_datetime, m.measurement_datetime, m.value_as_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.anaesthetic_id, m.measurement_datetime ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.measurement_id) AS kept_at_time FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.measurement_event_id = a.anaesthetic_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (21492241, 21490852) AND m.measurement_datetime >= a.start_datetime AND (a.end_datetime IS NULL OR m.measurement_datetime <= a.end_datetime) WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990002400'), stood AS (SELECT value_as_number, measurement_datetime, COALESCE(LEAD(measurement_datetime) OVER (ORDER BY measurement_datetime), end_datetime) AS until_datetime FROM reading WHERE kept_at_time = 1) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN value_as_number < 40 AND until_datetime IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) > 300 THEN 300 ELSE DATEDIFF(second, measurement_datetime, until_datetime) END ELSE 0 END), 0) / 60.0 AS minutes_below_40, COUNT(*) AS kept_readings FROM stood

expectations.says: Both means are written with the same time, the cuff mean of 35 and the arterial mean of 50.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = m.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990002407' AND ((m.measurement_concept_id = 21492241 AND m.value_as_number = 35) OR (m.measurement_concept_id = 21490852 AND m.value_as_number = 50))

cases: A neonate of 10 days with ten arterial means below 40 a minute apart, from 09:20 to 09:29, between means of 54 and 55, who died 30 days after the date of the start, should give 10 minutes below 40 and a death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with the same ten arterial means below 40, from 09:20 to 09:29, who died late on the 90th day after the date of the start, should give 10 minutes below 40 and a death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with the same ten arterial means below 40, from 09:20 to 09:29, who died just after midnight on the 91st day after the date of the start, should give 10 minutes below 40 and no death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with no recorded death, whose cuff means are 62 at 09:10, 35 at 09:20 and 60 at 09:40, should give 5 minutes below 40, because a reading stands for no longer than five minutes, and no death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with no recorded death, whose only cuff means below 40, 35 at 08:50 and 34 at 11:30, were taken ten minutes before the start and an hour after the end of an anaesthetic from 09:00 to 10:30, should give no minutes below 40 and no death within 90 days.
A neonate of 10 days with no recorded death, whose last cuff mean, 35 at 10:28, was taken two minutes before the end at 10:30, should give 2 minutes below 40 and no death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with no recorded death, whose anaesthetic has no recorded stop and whose last cuff mean, 35 at 10:00, follows means of 60 and 58, should give no minutes below 40 and no death within 90 days.

A neonate of 10 days with no recorded death, with a cuff mean of 35 and an arterial mean of 50 both at 09:10, should give no minutes below 40, because the arterial mean is kept, and no death within 90 days.
